references.text: Describes Jesus' ascent to the temple during a festival (Passover), parallel to the ascent during the Feast of Tabernacles in this verse.
Here too, Jesus appears in the temple during a Jewish festival and teaches/acts there.
Continues the description of Jesus teaching in the temple immediately after the Feast of Tabernacles, directly linked to the action in 7:14.
Describes King Solomon who went up to the house of the Lord (the temple) to offer sacrifices and worship during festival time, a pattern Jesus follows by going up to the temple during a festival.

Describes King Solomon gathering the people in Jerusalem during a festival and offering sacrifices at the temple, establishing the context that the temple is the place for worship and teaching during holidays.
